Conversation UI retains selectors, title editing, history pages and drafts. Scoped progress reads back off and cancel; reads and accepted SSE snapshots clear only their connection notice. Selection epochs and stream revisions reject stale success and failure callbacks. Safe execution failures remain distinct.
Desktop Git controls, safe parsed diff views, bounded workspace file previews and sandboxed explicit HTTP(S) browser frames.

Conversation service retains frozen configuration, READ/WRITE admission and metadata-only title edits. Observers receive committed safe prefixes and terminal snapshots, including whitelisted failure facts, partial artifacts and unknown cleanup outcomes. Provider exceptions remain private.

Transactional conversations preserve stable requests, workbench ownership, tombstones and non-replayed interrupted runs. Title edits preserve turn and execution state. Canonical SDK entries append behind RUNNING ownership; immutable prefixes and safe terminal failure facts remain durable.
simple-git wraps installed Git with allowlisted commands and server-owned roots; path validation, staged-only commits, non-force sync and redacted text previews.

Authenticated CSRF-protected conversation routes accept only fixed unique Pi extension IDs and reject model/workspace overrides. Authenticated write protection also covers idempotent title-only PUT requests with a required string title. The authenticated read surface includes the conversation SSE endpoint.
Wires concurrent conversation turns independently of serial explicit Git operations and child delivery; shutdown stops claim admission and drains all started batches.

Shared conversation DTOs expose bounded model recovery, safe failure facts and committed turn updates independently of execution status, retaining extension selections, history pages, title summaries and cursor contracts.

Independent conversations have no per-workbench, partner or global active-turn cap. Outbox batches renew per-delivery claims and drain on close; explicit Git remains serial and repository-coordinated.
Conversation acceptance defines ownership, configuration, archive, independent admission, safe context and child progress; imported missing-private-history markers remain internal under CHAT-37.

Global navigation uses user-selected Heartbeat for Joi and SquaresFour for workbenches; supports glyph-only collapse/expand, icon tooltips, retained page state and a narrow overlay. Archive navigation opens task/conversation tabs.

Responsive tool disclosures and theme-colored extension switches fit the composer popover. Switch tracks are 32x18 with centered 12px thumbs. User bubbles fit content within responsive limits. Reply copy controls reset padding and center 16px copy/success glyphs within 28px buttons.

Phosphor navigation icon comparison with 19px normal/collapsed samples and interactive pair previews. User selected A Heartbeat for Joi and 1 SquaresFour for workbenches; applied in Console navigation.
Archived conversation prose and recorded safe activity render without exposing tool results or replaying execution.
Compact history row with keyboard/hover tooltip and unclipped actions menu. Rename remains available during generation and restores trigger focus before opening the editor.

Conversation dialogs constrain keyboard focus, support Escape and confirm deletion with retry. Title editing selects the current title, validates the shared length bound, supports form submission and retains failed edits; pending writes block dismissal.
Nullable archive/deletion timestamps and visible-list index preserve existing conversation visibility.
Each turn displays only its latest thinking phase in stable tool disclosures, with expandable public summaries capped at 1200 Unicode code points; full history and tool pairing remain intact.
Conversation normalization preserves explicit tool lifecycle facts alongside bounded secret-masked presentation text.
Native tool lifecycle events project safe parameter summaries and typed started/completed/failed states for conversation persistence.
Stable child intent submission, cancellation and parent settlement through application ports.
Transactional child/outbox identity and interruption records; private child checkpoints remain outside projections.
Session-owned single-flight background batches validate frozen coverage; route-scoped backoff survives candidate changes; hard waits and cleanup are bounded and observable.

Pi SDK session restores versioned canonical entries and context edits through public SessionManager APIs. Incomplete effects become reference data. Resource discovery and SDK compaction remain disabled; configurable agent retries have zero provider retries.
Private normalized execution journal and native session references, independent of safe events.
Accepted conversation session, shared compaction, durable child-provider and reconnect boundary.
Context details show recorded usage, compression, last activity and child cancellation without an unknown-estimate placeholder or explanatory missing-private-history text.

Control requests can expire without retaining pending promises; close and exit reject pending calls, and late replies cannot resolve newer identities.
Worker start has a 60-second deadline and emergency stop/close have 15-second deadlines; terminal close terminates the owned worker and starts no retry loop.
